lead: Priyadarshan is an Indian film director, born on 30 January 1957 in Thiruvananthapuram.
As of 2026, he is 69 years old, and his birth date places him under the Aquarius sign.
He has 60 credited works on public record and has been recognised with Filmfare Awards South and Padma Shri in arts.
